abort.already_configured: This Resilio endpoint is already configured.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Resilio API.

error.path_mismatch: This path doesn't match the Resilio folder's own path, so backups written here won't replicate to peers. Submit again to use it anyway.

data_description.send_peer_invite: Adds a notification with a join link and QR code for this folder. Anyone with the link can join as a peer, so turn this off if you've already added the peers you need.

backup_path.description:
This is the local path Home Assistant writes each backup's `.tar`/`.json` files into. Resilio then replicates whatever it finds inside its own folder to your other devices, so this path should normally be the Resilio folder's own path (pre-filled below) or a location inside it.

Selected folder: **{folder_name}** ({folder_path})
backup_path.title: Choose backup path

folder.description: This is the Resilio Sync folder that actually replicates your backups to other devices. Pick an existing one, or choose "Create a new folder" to add one.
folder.title: Choose backup folder

new_folder.description: Enter the path for the new Resilio folder.
new_folder.title: Create a new folder

reauth_confirm.description: Resilio rejected the current credentials. Enter updated connection details.
reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with Resilio Sync

reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for this Resilio Sync endpoint. You'll be able to change the synced folder and backup path next.
reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Resilio Sync

user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the local Resilio Sync API.
user.title: Connect to Resilio Sync

data_description.scan_interval: How often, in seconds, to poll the Resilio Sync API for folder status.

folder_not_found.title: Resilio folder no longer exists
folder_not_found.description: The Resilio folder configured for this entry (`{folder_id}`) is no longer present on the Resilio Sync server. Recreate the folder with the same ID on the Resilio side, or remove and re-add this integration to select a different folder.
